purpose: Metadata-only investigation of conflicting Franklin County parcel records; no parcel geometries or owner values retained.

publisherProvenance.operator: Franklin County Property Valuation Administrator, with Schneider Geospatial-hosted GIS layer; the service itself identifies only the source as Schneider WFS and has blank layer copyright/description.

references.observation: Official Franklin County PVA page defines PIN as Property Identification Number (Map number); this establishes MAPNUM semantics but does not document row lifecycle or duplicate resolution.
Official PVA site says its property search exposes current certified tax roll; its linked viewer is not established here as a parcel geometry service.
Kentucky DOR states it supports local PVAs with mapping, provides GIS products for sale, and asks requests to start with the local PVA.

identityAssessment.nativeCandidate: PARCEL_ID (reported value: 061-00-00-103.00), also shown as MAPNUM in layer schema
identityAssessment.nativeCandidateStatus: Unusable as configured for canonical polygon identity: root-agent inspection found one PARCEL_ID on two records with distinct geometries. PVA documentation says PIN/map number is an identifier, but does not resolve duplicate feature rows. No GlobalID field exists.

otherFields.SOURCE_TYP: Coded values DEED, PLAT, PVA MAP, SURVEY; root observation indicates one duplicate each PVA MAP and DEED. Metadata description says Property Data Source Type, but does not say which is current authoritative parcel ground.
otherFields.SOURCE: String, no documented meaning or domain.
otherFields.v_SY: Integer year field, no metadata definition that establishes currentness or lifecycle.
otherFields.MAP_BLOCK_PARCEL: Visible cadastral components, but no source documentation reviewed says this tuple distinguishes legal parcels or explains how it should handle duplicate map-number rows.
otherFields.MAPNUM: String map number; known to duplicate PARCEL_ID in this service. Official PVA glossary calls PIN (property identification number) the map number, but this does not resolve row duplication.

reportedConflictingExample.geometryRelation: Root agent reported distinct geometries; no raw geometry retained.

identityAssessment.decision: No safe identity, current-ground filter, or evidence-backed parts mode found. Do not configure this layer for parcel binding from current evidence. Filtering SOURCE_TYP to PVA MAP or choosing a v_SY year would discard records without a documented current-ground rule.

alternativeEndpointInvestigation.status: Rejected: ArcGIS item extent is in Idaho (approximately longitude -112, latitude 42) and item owner is cityofpreston; this is Franklin County, Idaho, not Franklin County, Kentucky. It must not be used as the Kentucky replacement.

limitations: No complete parcel gate or geometry retrieval was run in this investigation.
No alternate Franklin County, Kentucky official parcel polygon service with documented stable native identity was found in the three focused publisher sources reviewed.
Official PVA site is access-restricted to direct fetch from this runtime; search-indexed official page content provided the PIN definition.
Duplicate-row facts and transport object IDs are from the root agent’s initial diagnosis; this subtask did not independently re-fetch those exact records.
